sources.title: Efficient LLM Inference: Bandwidth, Compute, Synchronization, and ...
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper presents a limit study of transformer-based large language model (LLM) inference, focusing on the fundamental performance bottlenecks imposed by memory bandwidth, memory capacity, and synchronization overhead in distributed inference systems.

sources.title: Understanding GPU-Level Bottlenecks in Large Language Model Inference
sources.snippet: We have analyzed kernel-level operations, its memory bandwidth utilization, and computational efficiency using the tool which we have developed, LLMTraceFX, a novel GPU-level profiling framework, across both single-GPU and multi-GPU configurations.
